short.hook_say: Don't let your rent renewal be a fight. Understand what changes, what stays, and how to protect yourself. A new agreement can save you stress and money.

tips.say: Always review your previous tenancy agreement. Note any clauses about renewal, rent increases, or notice periods. This sets the baseline for your new terms.
Talk to your landlord about any proposed rent increases. In Abuja, there's no cap on increases, but agreement is key. A clear discussion prevents surprises.
